title: BIA Disses Stefon Diggs Amid Her Feud With Cardi B: ‘Name Someone With More BMs Than Receiving Yards’
summary: Footage of Cardi's "Pretty & Petty" performance from the opening night of the Little Miss Drama Tour went viral.
contentText:
BIA reignited her feud with Cardi B and took a shot at Stefon Diggs in the process. What prompted the “Whole Lotta Money” rapper to take aim was footage of Cardi performing her BIA diss “Pretty & Petty” on the Little Miss Drama Tour going viral.

BIA Talks ‘BIANCA’ Debut Album, Cardi B & Unreleased Ariana Grande Collaborations: ‘I’m Now Representing Something Bigger’

A Timeline of Cardi B & Stefon Diggs’ Relationship

Cardi had the Acrisure Arena crowd fired up for the opening night of her tour in Palm Desert, Calif. Wednesday night’s (Feb. 11) setlist included her sniping at BIA’s discography on Am I the Drama ‘s “Pretty & Petty.”

“Name five BIA songs, gun pointed to ‘ya head/ Bow, I’m dead,” she raps on the track.

Footage of the moment eventually found its way onto BIA’s radar, which led her to take a jab at Stefon Diggs, who came up small in Super Bowl LX , as his New England Patriots were throttled by the Seattle Seahawks 29-13.

“Can u name someone with more bms than receiving yards? I can! and I know that… ykwnvm,” BIA replied on X on Thursday (Feb. 12).

Diggs finished with three catches for 37 yards, so BIA’s claim is fabricated. However, speculation followed the Super Bowl that Cardi and Diggs split after fans noticed the two had unfollowed each other on Instagram.

Entertainment Tonight confirmed via an unnamed source that the couple split “recently,” but reconciliation was still on the table. Diggs and the Grammy-winning rapper welcomed their first child together , and Cardi’s fourth, in November.

BIA explained to Hot 97 last year that the root of their issues stemmed from fans noticing that BIA’s Really Her EP from 2023 and Cardi’s “Enough (Miami)” track the following year seemingly had creative similarities. BIA also went on to diss Cardi on her “Sue Me” track in 2024.

After Cardi responded with “Pretty & Petty,” BIA decided to stand down and not distract from her BIANCA debut album with a diss track directed at Cardi on the LP. “If I was to ever address it again, I would never attach it to my album, because this is a beautiful body of work that I believe in,” she told Billboard in October. “I wouldn’t want to disservice this and overshadow it with noise or negativity.”

Cardi continues the Little Miss Drama Tour this weekend with shows in Las Vegas (Feb. 13) and Los Angeles (Feb. 15).
